adaptations: Thin API adapters preserve existing application handlers.
Dub default theme is registered for Tailwind v4; no custom component color theme.
Modal uses the real Next router context in Vite; visible titles and focus management are preserved.
Select adapts Dub Combobox with labelled triggers, keyboard focus for lists without search, and disabled options.
Textarea uses the same Tailwind forms styling; Sonner handles notifications.

resizable.note: Only the react-resizable-panels adapter remains from shadcn; see LICENSE.md.
